validation.notes: Repaired DefaultResourceLoader.reload in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: the bootstrap branch previously discarded the project trust resolver and forced projectTrusted = false unconditionally, which both never consulted the resolver and permanently denied project resources. It now awaits options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions }) exactly once, so the resolver is invoked with the untrusted bootstrap extension set (user/global plus temporary CLI extensions, no project extension) and the resolved boolean is applied via setProjectTrusted only after the promise settles. The regression (node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs, run from the workspace root) loads the real TypeScript source through the provided .prale-eval/subject.mjs boundary fakes and asserts: resolver called exactly once; resolver observes the untrusted bootstrap set (cli.ts + user.ts, no project.ts) with state.trusted === false and loadedTrust === false; while a deliberately deferred resolver promise is pending, no set/true event, no trust flip, and no project resource resolution occurs; a true decision loads project.ts alongside user.ts and persists trust; a false decision keeps project.ts denied while user.ts still loads and persists untrusted; and reload() without a resolver leaves existing trust untouched. Verified the regression exits 0 on the repaired source and fails with AssertionError 'project trust resolver must be consulted exactly once' (0 !== 1) when the original `const projectTrusted = false;` line is restored, then restored the fix. Limitation: the repository's vitest suite could not be run because node_modules are absent and dependency installation is out of scope for this task; the TypeScript module is still parsed and evaluated by Node 24 type stripping inside the regression.
